notes.title: Level Edylin completed and special offer!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29774715/f9661baf9e5bbcf2e4edcf72b01a0d27cdccff53.png
We're proud to announce that  Edylin, the first of the 4 main levels that define the world of  Ayren in which the adventure of Mydan takes place... is now (almost) completed! ːsteamhappyː
There are still some tweaks to be done here and there, but we can say it's shaping up nicely!

A lot of content has been added like:

    a brand-new stage with thrilling underwater action
    new dangerous enemies
    story hints that give you the first peek into Mydan's lore

Of course we also fixed some minor bugs and at least a nasty one that prevented the game from running properly on Oculus Rift.

  Let's celebrate with a 50% discount for a limited time! 

 Edylin (like all the main levels that will come with future updates) is based on this paradigm:

    2 objective-based levels
    1 runner-like level
    1 boss fight

You can expect a total amount of 20 stages at least once the game is completed.

Update the game right now and enjoy the new content, crafted with lots of love as usual!  Have fun with the new features and flood us with plenty of feedback!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29774715/e1cfbeaf81667705ae8b55e7f661e59e2b9aae49.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29774715/bcbd15939f7b46410ea7bf685d97bb79c73e5e58.png

notes.title: CO-OP is here!!! along with a new campaign and bunch of other stuff!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29774715/e1d030fbe5501700cdbf0e68e087f0ed15a0e675.png

We've been working very hard on making this huge communuty-feedback-driven update!

With this update we completely replaced the on-rails story mode. The story mode is now based on free-flight gameplay and it is playable in co-op with up to 2 players!

As of now there are 3 levels and we're planning on having 20 of them :)
Collectibles, unlockables and storytelling still need to be added, but they are coming very soon!
It has been a LOT of work, and we're aware that there might be big bugs, so we'll be all ears and eager to receive your feedback!

There are also countless other small fixes and updates, here is a list of the most important ones:
- overhauled Pelis Textures and shaders
- polished Kator waterfalls
- fixed a bunch of IK glitches
- removed initial "join online players or stay offline" menu
- replaced all enemy scripts with new, multiplayer-ready functionality
- rewrote all the AI
- added a dedicated tutorial level

We'd like to thank all the people who have supported us until now, we look forward on delivering more content and reach the final release as soon as possible!

Don't forget to join our discord: https://discord.gg/EbnV78

notes.title: Hotfix and updates
notes.content:
Another update for Run Of Mydan!

Here is a list of the major fixes:

- Not yet 100% tested freeze fix
- fixed bloom post-process that had disappeared
- downpowered orbs, which now act more like grenades and explode in proximity if 1 second has passed. Timeout explosion at 2 seconds after throw.
- increased spear throw angular velocity tolerance
- preview update for Pelis: still a prototype but a slightly improved visuals
- leaderboard with player rating based on ratio, number of kills and matches won
- fixed hitboxes which are now 4 boxes attached to the avatar: head, torso, left thigh and right thigh
- arm Ik fix when hands are behind body

notes.title: A known Issue and a little dev update!
notes.content:
There have been numerous reports regarding technical issues where the game completely freezes. We've found out that it's related to the Unreal Engine 4.17 and we're doing our best in trying to work around this problem.
So along with our apologies we also wanted to communicate that this problem is unfortunately at a lower level and is affecting many games based on Unreal Engine's latest version... If we cannot find a solution we'll fallback on earlier versions.

Besides bad and stressful news, we also wanted to announce that we'll soon be releasing an updated (yet still unfinished) version of Pelis (the prototype map :D). Here are some update pics:

notes.title: Run Of Mydan - hotfix
notes.content:
Hey there!
Here we are again, with some big fixes. We got reports of clients disconnecting during map transitions, and we hope that this issue is finally dealt with. We wish to apologize for the struggles we had with this, Unreal wasn't very helpful in this particular case! :)

- fixed that map transition thing
- fixed bug when pausing as a spectator
- fixed platform movement since the addition of new flight modes
- fixed machine gun click sound which wasn't spatialized

We are also working on bringing Pelis (the prototype map) to life, so expect an update with new content soon!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29774715/0a1d98cdfdd18e5f0caea86f28b2ff5e8a4ba55f.jpg

notes.title: Run Of Mydan 0.2.1.5 is out!
notes.content:
https://image.ibb.co/gsnHQm/capsule_616x353.jpg

Virtew is proud to announce another update for Run of Mydan.
In this update you'll have:

- loadout customization
- machine gun overheat (no spraying led anymore) 
- multiplayer audio spatialization fix 
- fixed map transition crashes in multiplayer
- added health and overheat indicators on both arms 
- slight changes to the slow machine gun tracers 
- added player name tags on lobby 
- basic proximity checks upon respawn in multiplayer 
- fixed issue where the counter would count two deaths instead of one if shot by two players 
- implemented basic, but slightly smarter team assignment algorithm 
- flight mode option so you can choose to fly by "pushing" or "pointing-in-direction" 
- added settings in In-game pause menu
- changes to the flight speed 
- added lobby options to change loadout and teams 
- reordering of rank based on kills in deathmatch
- fix prolonged post process effect after death﻿ on clients

can't wait to see you guys going at it online!

See you soon! :)
